sql: select count(*) as "count" from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and (fecha_ultimo_contacto IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_activities ac WHERE ac.deleted_at IS NULL AND (ac.lead_id=leads.id OR (ac.lead_id IS NULL AND ac.account_id=leads.account_id)))) = $1 and "fecha_proxima_accion" is not null

select * from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and (fecha_ultimo_contacto IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_activities ac WHERE ac.deleted_at IS NULL AND (ac.lead_id=leads.id OR (ac.lead_id IS NULL AND ac.account_id=leads.account_id)))) = $1 and "fecha_proxima_accion" is not null order by "fecha_creacion" desc, "id" desc limit $2 offset $3
